note: Every sheet is frames in a row (or rows) of w x h, nearest, whole multiples of 16. The same sheets in 2D and 3D.

blends.add: additive (light, fire, magic): in 3D the added batch, in 2D globalCompositeOperation lighter

behaviours.fly: moves from the caster to the target at `speed` cells/s, loops its frames; `orient` turns it along the path (2D rotate, 3D billboard about the view axis); `directions` picks a frame by the 8-way heading instead; on arrival plays `hit`
behaviours.drop: falls onto the target from `fall` cells above (avalanche rocks), then `hit`
behaviours.beam: a straight ray at once: `start` at the caster, the sheet tiled along the path, `end` at the target, for `ms`, then `hit`
behaviours.arc: as beam, but the tiles pick a random frame every step (`reroll`): a crackling lightning; `strike` at the target
behaviours.flash: plays once at a cell; `anchor` center (the cell middle, standing), feet (the figure's feet, standing, leaned like a sprite), floor (flat on the floor)
behaviours.splat: a flash flat on the floor whose `stay.frame` is left for `stay.ms`, fading
behaviours.wave: a ring flat on the floor round the caster, shown at the whole scale step that reaches `radius` cells, `rings` times `stagger` ms apart; throws `specks`; `tint` the screen (only the reader's if tintOnlyForReader) and `shake`
behaviours.tile: one cell of a cloud on the floor, looping; the row by the cell's gas volume (rows / volume); neighbours overlap, frames offset by (x + y)
behaviours.hang: stays over the figure for `hold` ms, looping
behaviours.particle: a speck thrown by a wave: drifts out (and up by `rise` px) for `life` ms

light: PointLight in 3D: color, intensity (r169 physical, the scale of hd2d-kit bolts), radius = distance in cells (decay 1.4), ms = how long, curve: flash (up 15 % then down), follow (with the bolt while it flies), along (the beam: the light at its middle), pulse (1.5 Hz), flicker (fire), steady. 2D: a soft disc of `color` at intensity / 8 alpha
shake: px = art pixels of the camera kick (fx.shake strength), ms
tint: a flash of the whole screen: color, alpha, ms (fx.flash)
reducedMotion: quality.reducedMotion: no shake, every tint at half its alpha
mobTrap: a trap set off by a monster: its flash and light, no shake and no tint

bolt.lightning.note: the whole room flashes for 0.08 s; shamans throw the same

gas.toxic.note: one cell of cloud: drawn flat over the floor at `lift` cells, neighbours overlap 2 px; the frame offset by (x + y) so a cloud never pulses as one

gas.paralytic.note: one cell of cloud: drawn flat over the floor at `lift` cells, neighbours overlap 2 px; the frame offset by (x + y) so a cloud never pulses as one

hit.crit.when: damage >= 30% of the target's max HP

quest.ore.nugget.note: the nugget on the floor for a moment (the item is the game's own after it); the gleam crosses it

quest.forge.note: a loop at the blacksmith's side

place.well.awareness.note: the water inside the well's rim, a loop; one row a kind of water

place.well.health.note: the water inside the well's rim, a loop; one row a kind of water

place.well.transmutation.note: the water inside the well's rim, a loop; one row a kind of water

place.shelf.note: plays once every 4-7 s on a lit shelf; the frames run the light over the spines

arena.dm300.debris.note: pieces thrown out of the burst: rows 0 plate, 1 gear, 2 bolt; the player picks a row a piece

arena.tengu.smoke.note: at both ends of the jump

arena.tengu.mark.note: where a shuriken struck the floor; rows 0-2 are three marks

arena.king.undead.note: before the undead dwarf's own sprite appears on the cell

moments.note: part 13: event keys for eventKey to learn (migration-p13.md), each to the effect it plays

ambient.note: loops the 3D view keeps while their cause is in sight; a key a terrain or a state, the value the effect (and its row)

garden.note: a firefly every 6 cells of high grass in a garden room, at night lights

steam.cells: the vents of the arena walls (pipes): every 3rd wall cell facing the arena

bosses.note: the staging of the bosses: what the 3D view does that is not a sheet

squash.note: [scaleX, scaleY, ms] of the sprite, feet fixed

dm300.note: a stage while health ≤ its share of the maximum (dents and black smoke at the last)

trace.note: the lost health stays pale this long, then shrinks in 4 steps (as the HUD's wound trace)

bossBar.show: from the boss card's end (bossCards.timeline.out) until the boss dies or leaves sight; the name and the icon from bossCards
